newsitem.title: UK: Med oil products ease as crude falls pressure.
newsitem.headline: Med oil products ease as crude falls pressure.

text.p: Med oil products were under pressure on Wednesday, traders said.

Naphtha was slightly weaker with crude. Vitol won all 24 cargoes of Suez naphtha, averaging 30,000 tonnes each, in EGPC's latest six-month tender. The award was made at the mean of fob Med quotes +$18.53, fob Suez. Vitol was also heard to have won 12 cargoes of Alexandria naphtha at +$10.03. Mira won nine cargoes at +$8.30, Marc Rich won four at +$8.23, and Stinnes six at +$8.10. The Alexandria cargoes were all about 25,000 tonnes.
EGPC had tendered for 36 cargoes but did not award the remaining five and may re-tender for these.
Gasoline eased with NYMEX futures but dealers said sales of gasoline to the U.S. from northwest Europe would support.

High sulphur fuel was under pressure in the wake of a reported deal between two traders on Tuesday of Italian barrels at $75.50 fob, which players said was very low, given the tightness of supply in the region.
"This is a concerted drive to push the Med quotes down," said one dealer.
One of the deal partners was heard offering Bilbao barrels at $86 cif basis Gibraltar but the trade was proving difficult to do, players said.
Both Russian and refinery cracked fuel appeared in very short supply.

A Turkish tender to be awarded on Thursday and a Greek tender closing next week for two 25kt cargoes of high sulphur straight-run for late June and early July should soak up fresh supply, traders said.

Gas oil continued to be on the weak side but some traders said it could be on the cusp of firming with a reopened arbitrage to the Far East. Russian material continued to be quoted around the quotes fob hi flat/+$1.0 level, while low sulphur material was talked around quotes fob hi +$2.0/+$3.0.
